__doc__: Integration-lane hand-off for the demand-driven mission job (lane sim-smart-job-feed-v2, Lane 1). The mission job is normally hardcoded in the scenario; --job-from substitutes an APPROVED store-vision restock plan, validated against scripts/planogram.json + the scenario single source (unknown SKU/slot refuses with a named reason, exit 2). Opt-in + default-off: absent --job-from the run is byte-identical. This file documents the producer -> consumer command sequence; it is NOT a runtime-config (--job-from is a CLI flag, no config key). See RUNBOOK sec 11a. No GPU is run from the job-feed lane; the integration lane runs the mission.

working_defaults.approval: pre-approved (the sim run is pre-approved; the gate is NOT consulted)

smart_variants.planner: --planner forecast | freshorder (opt-in; records provenance.planner_signal, keeps the resolved (sku, slot); forecast => task_kind stockout_forecast; freshorder => demand-driven order_cases, job quantity stays 1)
smart_variants.approval: run_mobile_restock.py --require-approval (opt-in; refuses a plan whose provenance.approval.state != 'approved')

step_1_produce_export_store_vision_reado.comment: Run with store-vision's own venv; reads store-vision READ-ONLY, actuates nothing, commits nothing there. Pick the planner (default restock). Firstmate default approval policy: auto_approve (gate off).

step_2_dry_run_resolved_job_no_gpu.comment: Resolve + print the mapped mission job + planogram validation without booting the simulator. Add --require-approval to enforce the approved missions record.

step_3_live_mission_integration_lane_onl.comment: The integration lane (sole GPU user, /tmp/aile-gpu.lock) adds --job-from to its normal --execute command. The fixed source/shelf camera targets follow the resolved job; the mission verify stage remains the stock-commit source of truth.
